description: This Java class defines a message envelope used in a distributed system, designed to hold message metadata and payload for sharded message handling. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and accessor methods for its fields.

classes.name: ShardedMessageEnvelope
classes.description: A message envelope that includes an ID, message type, message payload, and headers, with functionality for JSON serialization/deserialization and immutability.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ShardedMessageEnvelope with specified id, type, message, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ShardedMessageEnvelope object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message envelope.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the message.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ShardedMessageEnvelope with updated headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the envelope into a JSON object.
